## Why IcePanel

Today’s architecture docs are broken. They go stale the moment you ship, scattered across slides and wikis nobody trusts, and fall apart when the system gets real.

IcePanel is the architecture workspace that keeps product and engineering on one living model. From domains and services down to the flows between them.
